title: 24m x 10m Dream Shed
description: We designed this dream customised shed for a customer with a large car collection. Together with the design and engineering team at Stratco we came up with a practical solution that fit well and minimised  the planning constraints for the site.

title: Bespoke Garden Spa
materials: Stratco Highland tray cladding with Stratco Cooldek roof panels
description: We were commissioned to design a garden spa positioned to take advantage of sweeping hinterland views. Maximising the connection to the landscape was a key design driver, leading to the inclusion of large-scale glazing throughout the front elevation. A custom-engineered steel frame was designed and fabricated to accommodate a 5.8m x 2.2 m sliding glass door assembly. Together with the clean lines of the Highland Tray cladding, the glazing creates a refined contemporary form that responds sensitively to its environment while providing an exceptional indoor-outdoor experience.

title: Custom shed conversion
description: What was once unused shed space has been transformed into a striking modern office tailored to the owner's needs. The addition of a sleek awning and deck enhances both function and aesthetics, capturing picturesque views across the dam while blending the surrounding landscape with a contemporary interior.
